acceptanceCriteria.text: Root cause (permission boundary between the `runner`-owned 0700 MTNAI_BOOT disk directory and the nix-daemon build user under `__noChroot = true`) is confirmed or refuted with direct evidence (e.g. a CI run with added diagnostic `ls -la`/`stat`/`id` output at the point of failure).

Fix applied so the golden-path build can read the generated production bootstrap disk and private key regardless of which user executes the Nix build (e.g. relax directory permissions to at least allow read+execute for the build user, or run the generation step so the resulting tree is owned/readable appropriately).
`Runtime Appliance: canonical image / bounded manifest` job passes on a real push to main (not just a PR simulation), confirmed via a green CI run on main.
No weakening of the production MTNAI_BOOT/SSH boundary this test is meant to prove (Issue #630/#661/#768/#840) — the fix must not skip, mock, or bypass the real production bootstrap path.

issue.title: fix(ci): Runtime Appliance golden-path build fails on main since PR #849 (MTNAI_BOOT disk permission mismatch)
